admission.justification: The line is composed in one module and the pair is published in another, so a launch could name a file it never wrote; the first-message matrix reads the sent line and both files back on every harness.

applicability: Every role launch whose first message is sent to a host agent.
conditions: The line names the text artifact and the complete hand-over by absolute path and digest.
Both files exist before the message is sent; neither is written afterwards except by the restore of a saved launch.
exclusions: A launch prepared before the second file existed, whose saved message keeps the one-file line.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_role_first_message.py (artifact line, projection and pair checks across five harnesses); mcp/tests/test_paseo_agent_tools.py test_a_conflicting_complete_handover_refuses_before_the_text_is_created

statement: A role's first message opens with an artifact line naming both the hand-over text file and the complete hand-over JSON file by absolute path and digest, and both files are written before the message is sent.
